components.name: Primary Play Button
components.description: The single mint action that starts the selected game.
components.css: .ds-play { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 18px 0 22px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; border: 0; background: var(--mint); color: #11211d; font: 800 12px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-play:hover { background: #8aefd8; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-play svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; }

components.name: Game Selection Row
components.description: A full-width title selector with a mint active edge.
components.css: .ds-game-row { width: 100%; min-height: 69px; padding: 12px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .18s ease, background .18s ease; } .ds-game-row:hover, .ds-game-row:focus-visible { transform: translateX(6px); background: var(--panel); outline: none; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 var(--mint); } .ds-game-row small { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--muted); font: 8px 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-game-row b { margin-left: auto; color: var(--mint); } .ds-letter { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #53625b; font: 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Start.ng Identity Chip
components.description: A pill that distinguishes visitor preview from connected identity.
components.css: .ds-identity { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 9px 0 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #394740; border-radius: 999px; color: #c5cec7; font: 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-identity:hover, .ds-identity:focus-visible { border-color: var(--mint); color: var(--ink); outline: none; } .ds-identity i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--orange); } .ds-identity b { width: 23px; height: 23px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #34574f; color: #abf4de; font: 11px 'DM Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Full-Screen Game HUD
components.description: A compact score and state strip pinned above the immersive game canvas.
components.css: .ds-hud { min-height: 76px; padding: 17px 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; background: #111815d9; border-bottom: 1px solid #b1c4b528; color: var(--ink); font: 12px 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-hud small { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: #aebbb4; font: 9px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .11em; } .ds-hud strong { font: 700 25px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-hud em { margin-left: 5px; color: #b3c0b5; font: 11px 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-stat { color: var(--gold); } .ds-lives { margin-left: auto; color: var(--orange); }

components.name: Pause Control
components.description: Circular pause and resume control available during full-screen play.
components.html: <button class="ds-pause" aria-label="Pause run"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M6.5 4.5v11M13.5 4.5v11"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-pause { width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #72817a; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } .ds-pause:hover, .ds-pause:focus-visible { border-color: var(--mint); color: var(--mint); outline: 2px solid var(--mint); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pause svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.name: Game Result Panel
components.description: Square overlay for pause, win, and restart states.
components.html: Top of the world.3 stars collected · 750 pointsBack to games
components.css: .ds-result { width: min(360px, calc(100% - 36px)); padding: 27px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 11px; border: 1px solid #6f8174; background: #18211ff2; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px #0009; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-result strong { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-result span { margin-bottom: 8px; color: #c0c9bf; font-size: 13px; } .ds-result button { min-height: 43px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: var(--mint); color: #11211d; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; } .ds-result button:focus-visible, .ds-result a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mint); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-result a { color: #c0c9bf; text-underline-offset: 4px; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
The arcade places the player in a living Lagos street after dark: teal shop light, warm roadside lamps, painted stalls, produce, and small signs surround each playable Three.js world. Identity Dash, Avatar Jump, and Salubata share one character and one visual language while each game keeps its own clear play space.

The selection screen introduces the selected game over its 3D scene. Once a run starts, the world takes the full viewport and the surrounding site UI recedes. Score, turn or level, pause, touch controls, and result actions stay attached to the game so play can begin and end without losing context.
keyCharacteristics: Night-market atmosphere built from warm orange light and mint-teal accents.
Square editorial controls over dimensional, low-poly 3D streets.
A shared centrally styled character appears in all three games.
Full-screen play with compact in-world HUD and accessible exit controls.

rules.name: The Full-Screen Play Rule
rules.body: Keep active gameplay full-screen and keep pause or return actions reachable.

rules.name: The Shared Player Rule
rules.body: Use the shared character builder and pass through centrally supplied style fields.

rules.name: The Session Truth Rule
rules.body: Don't show the visitor preview as a verified Start.ng session.

dos: Do keep active gameplay full-screen and keep pause or return actions reachable.
Do use the shared character builder and pass through centrally supplied style fields.
Do reserve mint for active states and warm orange for street lighting and signs.
Do keep gameplay instructions specific to the selected title.
donts: Don't show the visitor preview as a verified Start.ng session.
Don't cover a running game with selection or profile panels.
Don't make decorative market scenery intersect gameplay paths.
Don't treat local browser checks as proof of the hosted Start.ng identity handshake.
